channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Qatar says US, Iran should not wait to reach a peace deal
item.description: Qatar's prime minister urges the US and Iran not to wait for a 'perfect moment' to reach a deal to end the war.

item.title: How Trump’s unconvincing narrative on Iran lost him the US midterms

item.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
item.description: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.

item.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
item.description: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.

item.title: Major construction ongoing near Iran missile bases, satellite images suggest
item.description: Evidence of digging and new buildings are visible in satellite imagery taken in November, satellite images suggest.

item.title: US midterm results spark fears in Israel over future of two countries' ties
item.description: Staunch US support of Israel has been raised as one of the reasons why Republicans performed so badly.

item.title: A wildfire killed their loved ones in Spain. These British families demand to know why
item.description: Nine British nationals were among the 15 people who died when fire ripped through the village of Bédar this summer.
